newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Shipping - Grain/oilseed cargoes - March 27.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Shipping - Grain/oilseed cargoes - March 27.

text.p: The following is the berthing schedule for major bulk vessels unloading at Taiwan's main grain ports at Taichung and Kaohsiung, as detailed on Thursday by Taiwanese surveyors:
The discharging cargoes are given in tonnes. Berthing dates
are for arrival in port/expected completion of discharge.
Commodity Tonnes Vessel Buyer Berthing
At Kaohsiung:
Wheat 8,100 Chettinad Tradition Flour ass Mar 26/27
Corn/soyb 56,700 Yick Kam Hui Shung Mar 29/03
Corn 54,000 Ever Blessing Marubeni Mar 22/28
At Taichung:
Soybean 56,700 Samsun Spirit BSPA-T Mar 16/21
Wheat 15,000 Chettinad Tradition Flour ass Mar 22/30
Corn 54,816 Marina Star CK Group Mar 19/28
Corn/soy 59,100 Nurth Princess CK Group Mar 27/11
Incoming Taiwan grain/oilseed shipments in tonnes with
scheduled dates of arrival. K is Kaohsiung; T is Taichung.
Taiwan also has bulk offloading facilities at Keelung.
